availability_policy: Monthly average published in the first business days of the following month; the value for month M is not available during month M. The retrieval timestamp in this manifest is when the file was downloaded, which is an upper bound on availability for the last observation and says nothing about when earlier observations became available.
revision_policy: Underlying daily quotes are essentially final, but the monthly average can change if a daily quote is corrected. Not point-in-time. FRED serves only the current vintage of a series; revisions overwrite history in place and this endpoint exposes no vintage. Historical vintages exist in ALFRED (https://alfred.stlouisfed.org) and are not read by this module. A sha256 here identifies the file downloaded, not what the series looked like on any earlier date.
warnings: values are an annualised rate expressed as a decimal after dividing the published percent by 100, on a discount basis, actual/360 basis. This is a rate, not a period return: converting it to a monthly or daily return requires an explicit, recorded compounding or day-count assumption that this parser does not make.
series definition: Monthly average of the secondary-market three-month Treasury bill rate quoted on a discount basis. The conventional monthly cash proxy in the US asset-pricing literature.
release timing: Monthly average published in the first business days of the following month; the value for month M is not available during month M.
revision behaviour: Underlying daily quotes are essentially final, but the monthly average can change if a daily quote is corrected.
transformation applied by the source: none (level, as published)
maturity: 3.0 months (construction: secondary_market_discount_rate). TB3MS, DGS3MO and DFF are not interchangeable; see fred.check_interchangeable.
